H1_H2: Conservative overall support requires positive crossed-bootstrap 95% lower CI bounds on both usable HB and external HB. Both endpoints nonpositive upper CI bounds -> not supported; mixed/uncertain endpoint evidence -> inconclusive. Endpoint-specific numerical verdicts retained.
H3: IID F1 and recall seed-bootstrap lower CI bounds must meet predefined -0.01/-0.02 bounds. Confirmed obfuscated-recall decline (upper CI<0) vetoes preservation; a negative point estimate with uncertain sign makes preservation inconclusive. No formal obfuscated noninferiority margin is asserted.
practical_criterion: Point-estimate external FPR absolute reduction >=0.10, IID F1 loss <=0.01, IID recall loss <=0.02 versus baseline.
interval_limitations: Five seeds; pointwise intervals. FPR crossed bootstrap resamples paired seeds and shared evaluation prompts. IID/obfuscated preservation uses conditional paired seed bootstrap on fixed benchmark prompts.
